title: Guitar Hero Live Microsoft Xbox 360 2015, 2 Discs - No Manual
descriptionText:
No manual, 2 discs.

Experience the thrill of rocking out with Guitar Hero: Live for Microsoft Xbox 360! This two-disc game features an immersive gameplay experience that will transport you to a live concert. With the ability to play along to the beat of your favorite tunes, this game is perfect for music and dance enthusiasts of all ages. 

Join the virtual band on stage and play some of the most iconic hits in the business. With a T-Teen rating, this game is suitable for all audiences. So, whether you're a seasoned pro or just starting out, Guitar Hero: Live is sure to provide hours of entertainment.
